_source: Derived from decentraland/governance (master) — src/routes/debug.ts (the committee-gated /debug backend: GET /debug returns DEBUG_ADDRESSES; POST /debug/trigger over FUNCTIONS_MAP = {runQueuedAirdropJobs, giveAndRevokeLandOwnerBadges, giveTopVoterBadges, restoreMissingUpdatesForumPost}; DELETE /debug/invalidate-cache; POST /debug/report-error), src/entities/Debug/isDebugAddress.ts (the useIsDebugAddress gate over DEBUG_ADDRESSES from src/constants.ts), src/.env.example + src/constants.ts + src/entities/Snapshot/constants.ts (frontend env var names: GATSBY_GOVERNANCE_API, GATSBY_SNAPSHOT_API, GATSBY_SNAPSHOT_URL, GATSBY_SNAPSHOT_SPACE, GATSBY_DEFAULT_CHAIN_ID, GATSBY_DISCOURSE_API), and ui3 GvDebugAdmin.jsx (which mirrors the legacy debug.tsx Admin/Debug panels 1:1). The live read paths come from catalyrst-governance (GET /governance/budgets paged {data,limit,offset} over archived transparency-budget payloads; GET /governance/health). Both 404 on https://catalyst.example.com today (the crate is staged but not yet deployed), so version/health/env and the transparency-budgets summary degrade to this fixture. Tool ACTIONS (TriggerFunction, BadgesAdmin, InvalidateCache, Notifications, Snapshot, QueryData) are committee-gated maintenance ops and are SIMULATED/inert here (read-only console; no write API surfaced to an anonymous browser session). Budget figures are realistic placeholders modelled on the public DAO transparency budget quarters.
